recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, sepia-toned close-up portrait of an elderly man with white hair, cropped so only the left half of his face is visible. The background is a soft-focus, textured outdoor scene. A single line of lowercase, condensed sans-serif text is positioned horizontally in the center-right negative space.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme asymmetrical balance between the detailed facial features on the left and the textured negative space on the right.
Tonal harmony between the warm sepia highlights and deep charcoal shadows.
Contrast between the sharp detail of the eye/skin and the soft-focus bokeh of the background.
coreInvariants: Visible film grain or halftone texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's face occupies the entire left vertical half of the frame at a 1:1 scale relative to the height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's left eye, positioned slightly above the horizontal midline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the detailed eye on the left, moves across the bridge of the nose, and follows the horizontal line of text into the dark background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right half of the image serves as active negative space, providing a dark, textured canvas for the typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value contrast. The image relies on tonal range rather than hue variety.
paletteRestrictions: No pure white; highlights should be cream-tinted

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the dark negative space adjacent to the subject's hair

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Color-based differentiation within a single typeface family.
graphicDevices: Halftone-like grain texture across the entire image

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, grotesque feel and narrow proportions.
Provides a clean, modernist look with similar x-height.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, sepia-toned duotone photograph of an elderly man with white hair, cropped vertically so only the left half of his face is visible. The right side should be a dark, out-of-focus background of trees or foliage.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of lowercase text in a condensed sans-serif font. The first half of the text should be white, and the second half should be a muted terracotta red. Position the text horizontally in the center of the right-hand dark area.

verificationChecks: Is the face cropped exactly at the midline?
Is the color palette strictly sepia/charcoal?
Is there a visible grain or print texture?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the red accent text
mustRedesign: Avoid using the specific name or likeness of the original artist
Do not include the punch-hole artifact in the top right corner
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible against the dark background.
Ensure the duotone effect is consistent across the highlights and shadows.
Verify that the crop feels intentional and not accidental.
Confirm the two-color text split is visually balanced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a high-detail portrait, apply a 50% vertical crop, convert to a warm duotone with heavy grain, and place a single line of lowercase condensed sans-serif text in the resulting negative space.
